lessons.description: Strings can be joined with `+` and characters accessed by index `s[0]`. Negative index `s[-1]` gives the last character.

lessons.title: 2. String Slicing
lessons.description: Slice substrings using `s[start:end]`. Omitted start defaults to 0, omitted end defaults to length. `s[:-1]` drops the last character.

lessons.title: 4. ID Badge Formatter (Practice)
lessons.description: Format user details into an ID badge string: `"ID: " + name.upper() + " (" + role + ")"`.
lessons.solution_code:
def format_badge(name, role):
    return "ID: " + name + " (" + role + ")"

lessons.title: 5. Unit 6 Checkpoint: Strings Mastery
lessons.description: wrap_string(s, char) must surround s with char on both sides, returning char + s + char using string concatenation.
lessons.solution_code:
def wrap_string(s, char):
    return char + s + char
